headline: Equinor Shuts Visund Platform in North Sea Following Fire
summary: Equinor halted production at its Visund oil and gas platform in the Norwegian North Sea following an electrical switchboard room fire, removing 13.2 million cubic meters per day of gas export capacity.
why: Equinor ASA is a major Norwegian energy company engaged in oil and gas exploration and production globally, particularly on the Norwegian continental shelf.

impacts.name: Equinor ASA
impacts.why: Halting production at a major platform removes output capacity, negatively impacting near-term operational volume.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sudden removal of 13.2 million cubic meters per day of gas export capacity from the market restricts supply, which can affect European natural gas pricing dynamics.
